headline: Viva takes over electronic payments for the Government of Cyprus
summary: Viva will handle electronic payments from citizens and businesses to the Cypriot state under a new contract. The total payment volume managed is expected to exceed EUR 1.5 billion annually.
why: Viva is a payments company operating in Europe, part of the digital payments sector. Public-sector payment contracts provide recurring processing volumes for providers.
